evals.name: fill-blanks-feature
evals.prompt: I want to add a 'cook later' list to Recipely — users can bookmark recipes to cook later, see them in a list, and remove them from it. I don't have time for a long back-and-forth today: fill the blanks yourself and just write the plan.
evals.expected_output: A brief understanding restatement, then a lean single-epic (or at most two-epic) OKF plan written to docs/PLAN.md, docs/index.md bootstrapped with okf_version 0.1, and docs/notes/understanding.md whose 'Assumptions made on the user's behalf' section records the autonomous decisions.

evals.name: project-with-transcript
evals.prompt: Let's plan snapvault properly now. It's a CLI tool that backs up selected folders to S3-compatible storage, with deduplication and client-side encryption. We already talked this through earlier, here's where we landed so you don't need to re-ask: solo devs and tiny teams, not enterprises. Restore is point-in-time by snapshot id, full folder or single file. Config is one TOML file per machine, no server component ever. Dedup at the chunk level (content-defined chunking), encryption with age, keys never leave the machine. Out of scope for v1: any GUI, Windows support, scheduling, multi-machine sync. Still open and I know it: retention policy design — don't decide it for me. Go ahead and write the plan.
evals.expected_output: A multi-epic OKF plan with self-sufficient '## Epic N:' sections carrying their own scope/acceptance criteria/dependencies, the stated out-of-scope items preserved with reasons, retention policy in 'Not yet specified' (NOT decided by the AI), and the decided constraints (TOML, age encryption, point-in-time restore) reflected in the plan and understanding doc.

evals.name: existing-plan-no-clobber
evals.prompt: Can you put together a plan for adding tags to notes? I want users to be able to tag their notes and filter the list by tag.
evals.expected_output: No overwrite: the pre-existing docs/PLAN.md (which already covers tagging) is left byte-identical; the final message points out the existing plan covers the request and offers to revise it / asks how to proceed instead of writing a new plan.
files: project with docs/index.md and docs/PLAN.md already covering the tagging feature

evals.name: unhurried-stops-at-understanding
evals.prompt: I want to build a habit tracker for the team inside teamtrack — can you plan it?
evals.expected_output: No plan written and no docs/ created: the session stops at gate 1 with an understanding restatement ('what I understood' in its own words + 'what I'm unsure about' questions) and waits for the user, because no speed signal was given and the human is unavailable.
